title: Official blog review packet stage 12
summary: This iteration adds an internal AI review packet for OpenAI and Anthropic official-blog intake. The packet converts preview feeds or existing intake queues into a minimal review contract: AI reviewers receive only the title, capped opening preview, deterministic triage, and suggested metadata needed to decide include, needs_review, or exclude. Ordinary company news remains excluded, durable product/model/engineering-practice posts can be included, and implementation-heavy customer or partnership stories are routed to manual review before curation.

validation_commands: node --test --test-name-pattern "official blog review packet|official-blog:review-packet" tests/official-blog-knowledge.test.js tests/unit.test.js

lessons.lesson: AI admission review needs a packet format that makes the preview-only rule enforceable.
lessons.evidence: Stage 12 adds `official_blog_review_packet` with `ai_review_contract.review_basis` set to `title_and_opening_preview_only` and explicit forbidden inputs for full body, source audit, candidate pool, and public HTML.
lessons.recommended_action: Use the review packet, not raw crawl output, when asking AI to make the first-pass official-blog admission decision.

lessons.lesson: Borderline customer or partnership stories should not be auto-curated just because they mention AI workflows.
lessons.evidence: The packet keeps deterministic `needs_review` decisions and marks those items with `manual_review_required` before any translation or knowledge record authoring.
lessons.recommended_action: Require human review for customer or partnership articles unless the opening preview clearly shows reusable engineering implementation detail.

lessons.lesson: Internal review artifacts must stay out of the public site tree.
lessons.evidence: The `official-blog:review-packet` CLI refuses `docs/data`, `docs/official-blogs`, and public HTML output paths with `official_blog_review_packet_public_output_forbidden`.
lessons.recommended_action: Keep review packets in ignored local or internal workflow paths; only reviewed curated records should enter public data.

suggestions.issue: After defining the official-blog admission policy, there was still no stable artifact for giving AI only the minimal first-pass inputs needed to apply it.
suggestions.evidence: Stage 12 adds `createOfficialBlogReviewPacket` and `official-blog:review-packet`, plus tests proving raw body text, source audit, and candidate pool internals do not leak into review items.
suggestions.suggestion: Route new OpenAI and Anthropic blog candidates through the internal review packet before translation, summary authoring, or knowledge graph insertion.
suggestions.expected_benefit: Daily generation and later blog curation can consistently link high-value product, model, and engineering-practice posts while excluding low-signal company news.
suggestions.promotion_path: Implemented through pure function and CLI coverage, with public output guards for the internal artifact.
validation_evidence: official blog review packet packages preview-only AI review items without leaking internals
official blog review packet accepts existing intake queues
official blog review-packet CLI writes a clean internal AI review packet
official blog review-packet CLI refuses public output paths

followups.action: Wire live official-blog discovery to emit preview feeds into `official-blog:review-packet` once the source-fetch stage is implemented.
Add the reviewed AI decision output schema in a later stage so accepted review-packet items can become draft curated records without carrying queue internals forward.
